tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background of every screen (warm aluminium by day, night by night).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs and neutral panels that belong to no speaker.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: The fan's own message bubbles and segmented-control tracks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers. Decorative only: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: control-line
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and outline buttons (3:1 or more on ground and surface in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface, surface-sunken and team-surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, system lines and helper copy on ground, surface, surface-sunken and team-surface (5.3:1 or more).

tokens.name: ai-surface
tokens.usage: The AI's panel: every message written by Maya's AI and the AI's half of an approved draft.

tokens.name: ai-line
tokens.usage: Hairline around ai-surface panels, citation chips and memory chips. Decorative; the label carries the meaning.

tokens.name: ai-ink
tokens.usage: The AI's color: its ring mark, its label text and the send button, on ground, surface and ai-surface (5.3:1 or more).

tokens.name: on-ai
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ai-ink fill, such as the send button and Message Maya's AI.

tokens.name: maya-surface
tokens.usage: The creator's surface: her replies, Notes, corrections and anything else she signs. Never used for the AI or the team.

tokens.name: maya-line
tokens.usage: Border of maya-surface elements and of split approved drafts.

tokens.name: on-maya
tokens.usage: Maya's words and primary text on maya-surface (12.6:1 or more).

tokens.name: on-maya-muted
tokens.usage: Timestamps and secondary text on maya-surface (6.7:1 or more).

tokens.name: maya-accent
tokens.usage: Maya's color on her own surface: her seal, the Signed marker and her label on maya-surface (6.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: on-maya-accent
tokens.usage: The initial inside a filled seal and text on a maya-accent fill.

tokens.name: maya-ink
tokens.usage: Maya's color on neutral grounds: her label, the step-in button outline and stamps on ground or surface (8.2:1 or more).

tokens.name: team-surface
tokens.usage: Messages from Maya's team. Neutral on purpose: never her surface or seal.

tokens.name: team-ink
tokens.usage: The team's dashed mark and label on team-surface and ground.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Overdue commitments and errors the person can fix, as text or an icon on ground and surface. Always with a word; never for a decline.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on neutral surfaces: a 2px gap in the ground, then a solid 2px ring.

tokens.name: focus-on-maya
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring for controls sitting on maya-surface.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The creator's name on her home page. Once per screen.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Sheet titles and the titles of moments that matter (the packet, a receipt).

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Section headings on the creator home and in the studio.

styles.name: voice-lg
styles.sample: Single dip, count to three, and let it drip off.
styles.usage: Text Maya wrote herself: her replies and Notes. Never for AI output.

styles.name: voice-md
styles.sample: My AI got this wrong: my celadon is fired at cone 10.
styles.usage: Corrections, receipts and compact places where Maya's own words appear.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen and card titles, the name in a thread header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Crawling at the rim usually means the coat went on too thick.
styles.usage: The AI's messages, the fan's messages and all running interface text.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text and option titles.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Author labels, buttons in dense rows, chips.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Only Maya and her team see replies to Notes.
styles.usage: Helper text, fixed notices and metadata under controls.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: Counts on the creator home and in the studio.

styles.name: data-md
styles.usage: Prices beside modes and on receipts.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Timestamps, request IDs and uppercase meta lines.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a message's label and its bubble group items; inner padding of chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, bubble and card padding, gap between messages.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of sheets and large cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major sections on the creator home.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Height of inputs and the composer row; the minimum for primary buttons.

tokens.name: radius-tail
tokens.usage: The corner of a bubble nearest its speaker (top-left for incoming, bottom-right for the fan).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips inside bubbles, small plates such as a reaction.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, list groups, option rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Message bubbles, buttons and cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets and the creator-home hero plate.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Seals, the step-in button, reactions and status pills.

shadow.note: Shadows mark the creator's presence and lifted overlays, nothing else.

tokens.name: shadow-plate
tokens.usage: Maya's Note card and the creator-home hero plate.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and dialogs: the packet, the signing sheet, a confirmation.

tokens.name: glow-maya
tokens.usage: House lights: only on Maya's live messages, the Maya is here line and her avatar while she is in the conversation.

tokens.name: z-strip
tokens.usage: The identity strip, which never scrolls away.

tokens.name: z-composer
tokens.usage: The composer pinned to the bottom of a thread.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the signing sheet.
